name: Daronas
source:
Guard captain.

Always loyal to the Human Empire, he chose to be assigned in the cold, far north regions because of his past. A man of honor, he doesn't always approve of the Empire's methods, in particular towards the other races that populate Aravorn.

[Edited from [url=http://www.winterwolves.net/viewtopic.php?f=40&t=3053]Winter Wolves[/url]]
